hall: The Town Hall is where Nib keeps the big book of every resident. There’s nothing to do inside yet.
bank: The bank is a cash machine. There’s nothing to do here yet.
print: The print shop has sticker packs in its window. Nothing to do here yet; buy packs in the site’s shop.
wheel: Twirl’s Wheel of Peel gives one free spin a day. Paid spins cost a few coins, feed the pot, and one wedge wins it.
exchange: Tally keeps the Exchange. Bring all that a resident’s order asks for, and she pays.
counter: This is the Arcade’s prize counter. Prizes are won at the cabinets; nothing to do here yet.
cart: The fruit cart will sell duck bread. Nothing to buy here yet.
fountain: The fountain in the square works. There’s nothing to do but look.
orchard: The orchard by the lemonade stand will drop apples for your animals. Nothing to pick yet.
monument: This monument is an unmarked banana statue. Nobody knows who it is; nothing to do here yet.
terrace: This is the Coffee Cup’s terrace. There’s nowhere to sit and nothing to do here yet.
cut: This road leads north, out of town. It goes nowhere yet.
gardenE: This is the Coffee Cup’s garden. Nothing to do here yet.
gardenW: This is Gran Fig’s flower garden. Nothing to do here yet.
oldCabinet: This old arcade cabinet is out of order. There’s nothing to play here yet.
